description: React component for displaying system notices in Mattermost, including logic for visibility, dismissal, and user interaction.

classes.name: SystemNotice
classes.description: React component class for rendering system notices with user interaction capabilities.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches standard analytics if user is a system admin upon component mount.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Refetches analytics if system admin status changes to true.

methods.name: getCurrentNotice
methods.description: Determines the current notice to display based on dismissal status, admin restrictions, and show conditions.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Dismisses the current notice, optionally saving preferences to remind later or dismiss permanently.

methods.name: hideAndRemind
methods.description: Hides the notice and sets a reminder for later.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the notice UI, including title, body, icons, and action buttons.
